BIOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BIOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Genetics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Genetics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Genetics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Genetics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Genetics.

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Iron rusting

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support in Plants.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support in Plants.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Support in Plants.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support in Plants.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement in Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement in Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement in Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement in Animals.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Animals.

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: CELL BIOLOGY AND BIODIVERSITY S.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination in Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination in Plants.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination in Plants.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination in Plants.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination in Plants.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C.

16. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 2.2 Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Support and Movement 3.0 Anatomy and Physiology of Animals 3.1 Response and Coor and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Support in Plants and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination 3.2 Support and Movement Page 12 of 38 1 STRAND 1.0: C and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Response and Coordination in Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
